description: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ “ . . . one dab and my brain said ‘let’s light a candle and confront some things.’” The Spice is warm, complex, and slightly mysterious. Think clove, cinnamon bark, soft pepper, and a sweet herbal backbone that feels intentional, not seasonal. The high is smooth and cerebral with a calming body glide. #1 in Michigan. House-Made by Detour Farms.
